description: US home-cleaning services brand (carpet, area rug, upholstery, tile and grout, air duct and hardwood cleaning) built on its Zero Residue / Zr Water cleaning technology, with 70+ locations across the United States. Its affiliate program pays creators and publishers a flat commission for every completed job they refer.

evidence.summary: Official Zerorez blog post announcing the affiliate program, fetched in full: 'You will earn $40 for every job you send our way, with no limit to how much you can earn!' Program features: $40 commission for completed jobs, 60-day cookie duration, monthly payouts, a dedicated affiliate manager and a monthly affiliate newsletter. Sign-up runs through Impact (the post links to the Impact Zerorez signup page and directs applicants to zerorez.com/affiliates). Open to anyone with a social media channel, email list, blog, platform or website; the brand says it especially encourages lifestyle, home decor, cleaning, real estate and family creators. The explicit 'no limit to how much you can earn' statement on the brand's own page makes the commission cap UNCAPPED. The pay is a flat $40 bounty per completed job, not a percentage, so commission_rate is null.

The same official post states Zerorez has operated for over 20 years, holds over 190,000 5-star Google reviews at a 4.9-star average, has more than 70 US locations, and pays commission on carpet, area rug, upholstery, tile and grout, pet spot/odor, mattress, stone, air duct and hardwood floor cleaning services. This affiliate program is separate from Zerorez's customer Refer-A-Friend scheme ($25 gift card), which is not the route recorded here.
